floor:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a flat overhead historical floor-map texture for the Gaziantep Panorama 25 Aralik Museum, for mapping onto a 3D floor.
The three input photographs are overlapping original views of the SAME map painted/printed on the museum floor. Recover the map artwork from these views into ONE coherent, clean, top-down orthographic map. Use image 2 (IMG_1976) as the main layout/orientation reference, and images 1 and 3 to corroborate matching features.
Remove all museum architecture, columns, people, reflections, glare, ceiling, lighting, tile glare, and perspective distortion. Deliver only the flat map artwork, square composition, suitable as an opaque albedo texture. Preserve the visible historic Antep city layout: dense irregular terracotta/orange urban blocks with fine dark street outlines; the recognizable fortified castle mound in its green enclosure; the winding blue/turquoise stream that curves around that area; olive-green open land, brown terrain, broad dusty-rose route bands, and the red dashed route visible in the sources. Keep their relationships and course faithful to the same source map. Do not turn it into a modern generic city or add fictional monuments/streets.
Preserve only clearly readable authentic labels and marks. Do not invent readable historical names, dates or cartographic facts. Use restrained neutral continuation at genuinely unobserved outer margins instead of inventing new city detail. Keep the museum map's existing hand-rendered cartographic/terrain appearance, clear fine lines and printed colors, without a border, title card, legend panel or decorative elements. High resolution and uniform matte lighting.
These supplied images are tightly cropped floor regions from the original photographs, normalized to ordinary sRGB PNG. Extract their actual map content rather than depicting a museum room.
legend_background:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an edit of the attached board texture for a museum reconstruction.
Remove ALL small white body text and ALL numbering from every column and from the right-side reference list. Remove all generated place names and sources completely. Leave those body areas EMPTY with a continuous matching dark charcoal/brown subtle historical-map background.
Preserve only these exact top headings and subtitles in their current positions and style: "Haritada Gösterilen Yerler", "Places Shown on the Map", "Harita Kaynakça", "Map References". Preserve the red/white "PANORAMA 25 ARALIK" logo at the lower left. Keep the same aspect ratio, borders, colors and background texture.
Do not add or regenerate any replacement body text, numbers, placeholders, rules, fake lines or new labels. The real source lettering will be composited as a separate original-source layer in the 3D model. Output a clean, flat opaque albedo texture.
lettering: Original native-resolution source crop mapped onto the board via projective UVs. Generated place names/numbers were rejected.
